item.title: Sneaker Captions Stay Safely Inside

turns.text: Make a silent 15-second 9:16 sneaker ad. No photo—use a plain white leather low-top with white laces and a white sole, no logo. Three moving shots, with these captions in order: “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.”, “Shop now”. Keep all captions at least 15% in from either side and 20% from the top and bottom so reel buttons won't cover them.

item.tests: Tests caption accuracy, legibility and explicit safe-area placement throughout a finished vertical product ad.

answer_sheet.Product and reference: No photo; generate a plain white leather low-top sneaker with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
answer_sheet.Shot style: Three moving product shots; backgrounds, lighting and transitions are your call.
answer_sheet.Caption wording and order: “Meet your everyday pair”, then “Clean look. Easy style.”, then “Shop now”.
answer_sheet.Caption placement: Every caption, including its full text bounds, must stay at least 15% from each side and 20% from the top and bottom.
answer_sheet.Caption styling: Your call; make it easy to read on a phone.
answer_sheet.Format, duration and audio: One silent 15-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One silent 9:16 video runs for approximately 15 seconds and contains three moving product shots.
The sneaker is consistently a white leather low-top with white laces, a white sole and no logo.
The captions read exactly “Meet your everyday pair”, “Clean look. Easy style.” and “Shop now”, in that order.
Every visible caption's full bounds stay within the central 70% of frame width and central 60% of frame height, including during transitions.
Captions are legible against the footage and remain visible long enough to read.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a sneaker ad, and I don't have a photo, so please generate a plain white leather low-top sneaker with white laces, a white sole, and no logo. I've been thinking about this little ad for a while and am excited to see it come together. What I need is a silent 15-second 9:16 video with three moving shots of the product. The captions should appear in this exact order: “Meet your everyday pair”, then “Clean look. Easy style.”, then “Shop now”. My main worry is that reel buttons might cover the words when someone watches it. Please keep every caption, including its full text bounds, at least 15% in from either side and 20% from the top and bottom so those buttons won't cover them.
